Henderick content plan · For review · Version 2

The content plan, in one place.

Everything we will capture, publish and build for Henderick through the first months of our agreement. It is built from footage we have already captured at Dodson Elementary and RH Boyd, organized around the 3 divisions your team sells, and measured against the deliverables in our services agreement. Mark up anything you would like changed and we will update the final version.

The test every piece has to pass

Can Jennifer, Caroline, Will or anyone else on your team send this to a prospect and have it do work? Every post, page and video in this plan is built so someone on your team can put it in front of a facility manager, a school district or a property owner. That is how this program turns into inquiries and pipeline, which is what our agreement measures.

How to review
  • Every item is numbered straight through the document, 01 to 34, so feedback can simply reference a number.
  • Ready means the footage is captured. Capture means it depends on an upcoming session.
  • Page 5 shows the motion graphics and edit we have already built from the first 2 sessions.
  • Page 2 shows each month's deliverables from the agreement and where each one appears in this plan.

How performance is measured at the end of the term

Qualified inquiries and where they came from, cost per inquiry, pipeline created (named opportunities, quotes and site visits), the content library Henderick owns, and the search presence we build. That is why the website and Google work on page 7 matters as much as anything on the social calendar.

Chapter 03 · The approach

Built around the work you sell.

Content is organized by division, so every post feeds a landing page, a Google Ads campaign and a salesperson. The formats come from the ideas your team has already shared.

Division

Flooring and Athletic Surfaces

Gym floors, refinishing and replacement. Year round and fully in house, so it leads.

Sold by: Jennifer. Feeds: athletic surfaces page and ads.

Division

Paving and Site Work

Courts, lots, striping and drainage. Seasonal, so we capture what we can before winter.

Sold by: Caroline. Feeds: paving page and ads.

Division

Construction Services

Interior renovations and facility projects like RH Boyd.

Sold by: Will and Waddell. Feeds: construction services page and ads.

Across all 3

The Henderick Team

The people behind the work, which is what sets a local contractor apart.

From Eleonor: meet the team, day in the life, branded shirts and truck in frame.

Formats your team asked for
  • Episodes. "In this episode we are tearing out the floors of a 110 year old school." Footage carries the story, a voice explains it. Will narrates.
  • 2 Minute Reads. Short LinkedIn lessons from Waddell and the field team, as Eleonor suggested. The first one is already on camera.
  • Project Spotlights. Before and after with Eleonor's structure: just completed, we can do this for you, call us today.
  • Jennifer in voiceover. Her knowledge carries the flooring content without putting her on camera.

Chapter 04 · How each session works

One session, a month of content.

Our agreement defines a session as one subject carried from planning through filming, editing and publishing. Each one is planned so a single visit produces everything on the right, without slowing your crew. If a shot would slow or block the work, we drop it.

Before · 1 week out

Plan

  • Site, date and crew confirmed from your production schedule
  • Written permission from the owner or district, drafted by us
  • Shot list and the 6 to 8 hooks we will film, written in advance
On site · half day

Capture

  • Wide drone and site shots from fixed angles we repeat on the next visit
  • A batch block: every vertical hook filmed back to back in about 30 minutes
  • 1 short interview or voiceover
  • Stills throughout
Within 5 business days

Edit

  • 1 hero, 3 to 4 verticals, 1 carousel
  • 18 or more graded stills to your library
  • Ad versions in every ratio Google and Meta need
Following 2 weeks

Publish

  • Scheduled on the calendar after your review
  • Project update on the matching landing page and Google profile
  • Results in the Friday update
Every piece in the right shape for where it runs
16:9
9:16
4:5
1:1
FormatSizeUsed for
16:9 horizontal3840 x 2160Hero pieces, landing pages, YouTube, the longer film, Google Ads video
9:16 vertical1080 x 1920Instagram and Facebook Reels, Stories, vertical ad versions
4:5 portrait1080 x 1350Feed posts and carousels on Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn, LinkedIn video
1:1 square1080 x 1080Ad versions for Google and Meta placements
StillsFull size JPEGYour library, landing pages, Google Business Profile and carousels

We film in 4K horizontal and frame with the center protected, so one take yields every ratio above without losing the subject. Text and logos stay inside the safe area of each platform so captions and buttons never cover them.

Chapter 07 · Website, Google and inquiries

Turning content into calls.

We reviewed henderick.com on October 24. Henderick did not appear for any of 7 Nashville searches we tested, including "parking lot striping Nashville" and "gym floor replacement Nashville." The pages that rank for those searches are built around one service with the city in the title. Our landing pages and Google Ads campaigns are built the same way, so the two work together.

Standards on every shoot
  • Same drone angles before and after on every exterior project.
  • The Henderick truck in frame where the site allows, and crew in branded shirts once they arrive.

How reviews and reporting work
  • Every Friday, a short written update: what went out, what is next, and anything we need.
  • Reviews: each piece includes 2 rounds of revisions. As our agreement sets out, work not returned within 5 business days publishes on schedule unless you ask us to hold it.
  • Each month, a performance report and a working session: inquiries, cost per inquiry, pipeline, library and search.
  • Before the term ends, a review meeting at least 2 weeks ahead. With the holidays, we propose the week of December 14.
